messages:
kevin: Hey team — noticed our daily usage chart for AcmeCorp shows a weird repeated spike around 23:00 local time and the exported CSV seems to double-count some tokens across two days. Happening for multiple days this week. Can someone look? :frowning:

anna: sorry to hear that, can you attach the CSV export (or paste first 10 rows) and confirm your org time zone? also which report — dashboard 'daily usage' or the billing export? :eyes:

kevin: attaching CSV (first 8 rows pasted below). Org tz is America/Chicago. This is the "daily usage" dashboard and the export from Console > Analytics > Exports.
kevin: CSV snippet:
```
org_id,day,start_ts,end_ts,tokens
acme,2026-03-15,2026-03-14T23:00:00-05:00,2026-03-15T00:00:00-05:00,12450
acme,2026-03-16,2026-03-15T23:00:00-05:00,2026-03-16T00:00:00-05:00,11820
```
kevin: you can see the same 23:00 window showing up in both 2026-03-15 and 2026-03-16 exports.

jordan: thanks, that snippet is helpful. quick hypothesis: ingestion/day-bucketing may be using UTC midnight rather than org-local midnight, so events at 23:00 CST (which is 04:00 UTC next day) could be mapped inconsistently between the dashboard aggregation and the export job. Did Acme change their org tz recently? :thinking_face:

kevin: no changes on our side, been America/Chicago for months.

jordan: ok. can you confirm whether the dashboard time selector was set to "organization TZ" or "UTC" when you viewed it? also which export option (daily vs calendar-day)?

kevin: dashboard shows "org timezone" in UI. Export used "daily (midnight to midnight)".

anna: assigning to eng-analytics, tagging @jordan. I'll create a case and mark P2. maria, any billing exposure here if counts are doubled for a few customers?

maria: potentially, yes — if exports feed downstream billing recalculation. We need to know scope (# orgs affected + timeframe). Please add that to the case. :exclamation:

jordan: pulling logs from the aggregator service for Acme timestamps around 2026-03-15 22:30–00:30 CST. Found this query used to compute day bucket in nightly export job:
```
-- export day bucket (current)
SELECT org_id,
       DATE_TRUNC('day', received_at) AS day_bucket,
       SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage_events
WHERE org_id = 'acme' AND received_at >= '2026-03-15'::date
GROUP BY 1,2;
```
jordan: note: received_at is stored in UTC without timezone conversion and DATE_TRUNC defaults to UTC day boundaries in the job runtime. dashboard aggregation code uses the org tz when rendering. mismatch.

jordan: proposed fix for export job:
```
SELECT org_id,
       (DATE_TRUNC('day', (received_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'))::date AS day_bucket,
       SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage_events
...
```
jordan: or better: store a normalized day_bucket at ingestion time using org tz so both systems read the same column.

kevin: that matches what we see. Any ETA for a fix? We need correct numbers for next week's executive report.

jordan: temporary mitigation: I can run a one-off backfill for Acme for the last 7 days that recalculates day_bucket using org tz and regenerate the CSV. That will be manual and take ~30–45 min. Permanent fix will be a code change in nightly export pipeline and an ingestion backfill. I'll open a PR today.

ops-ci-bot: New ticket created: INF-2098 "export: day_bucket use org tz" assigned to eng-analytics, priority P2. Deployable change queued.

anna: thanks. kevin — i'll DM you when the backfill CSV is ready. can you confirm we should regenerate exports for 2026-03-08 through 2026-03-16? (last 9 days)

kevin: yes please, include 3/9–3/16. also please CC my billing contact maria@acme.com when you send regenerated CSV.

maria: noted, will hold billing adjustments until corrected exports land. please include a summary of affected rows and token delta.

jordan: putting quick repro steps in the ticket so SRE/devops can validate: 1) run SQL with DATE_TRUNC without tz and with tz; 2) compare counts per day; 3) run backfill script for org_id and verify dashboard matches regenerated CSV. I'll attach queries and sample diffs.

kevin: appreciate the quick responses. :thumbsup:

anna: marking this thread as in-progress. tagging on-call eng if the backfill needs additional capacity. :white_check_mark:

ops-ci-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for branch fix/day-bucket-tz (CI: passed).
